title: bento/slides document
description: The #bento-doc JSON of a Bento Slides file, generated from the app's validation tables. Guide: https://bento.page/agents.md

text.description: text element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

shape.description: shape element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

image.description: image element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

svg.description: svg element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

chart.description: chart element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

table.description: table element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

media.description: media element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

embed.description: embed element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

code.description: code element; x/y/w/h in slide px (1280×720 default); a stable id pairs morphs

slide.description: stateOf = hidden variant reached by a link; transition morph pairs same-id elements

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family stack for body text

headingFamily.description: display face for headings; absent = fontFamily

assets.description: key → data: URI or svg, used as asset:<key>

compact.description: input only: omitted fields take editor defaults (AGENTS.md)
